name: budget-guard
description: Stretches a Claude subscription: keeps the main prompt cache warm while idle, warns on 5h/7d limits and an approaching compaction, guards prompts sent into a cold cache.

keepalive.title: Keep the prompt cache warm
keepalive.description: While the main thread is idle, re-read its cached prefix through a fork shortly before the 5-minute cache expires.

keepaliveMinutes.title: Keepalive horizon (minutes)
keepaliveMinutes.description: How long after the last real request to keep pinging. A ping costs ~1/25 of a cache rebuild on Opus.

keepaliveMinTokens.title: Keepalive minimum context (tokens)
keepaliveMinTokens.description: Below this context size a rebuild is cheap and no ping is sent.

coldCacheGuard.title: Prompt into a cold cache
coldCacheGuard.description: confirm: hold the first prompt after the cache expired on a large context and put it back for a second Enter; warn: toast only; off.

coldCacheMinTokens.title: Cold-cache guard minimum context (tokens)
coldCacheMinTokens.description: Context size from which a cold-cache prompt is held or warned about.

limitThresholds.title: Rate-limit warnings (%)
limitThresholds.description: Comma-separated 5h/7d usage percentages that raise a toast; 90 and above also notify.

budgetNudgeAt.title: Tell the model about the budget from (%)
budgetNudgeAt.description: From this 5h or 7d usage, each prompt carries a hidden one-line budget note for the model (cache-safe). off disables it.

contextThresholds.title: Context warnings (% of the compaction window)
contextThresholds.description: Comma-separated fill percentages of the auto-compact window that raise a toast.
